sections.observation: Definitions distinguish on-premises business and off-premises advertising; area depends on exposed faces. Content-based exclusions and billboard wording require current legal review, not automatic permit exemption.

Advertising sign setback depends on district front yard; facing restrictions address residential lots and listed civic/institutional sites. Expressway advertising expressly cross-references Chapter 711.
Real-estate sign provisions distinguish individual and aggregate area, yard-relative setback and flat wall placement; these are category-specific candidates, not universal sign limits.
Home-occupation/dwelling professional or announcement signs and institutional bulletin boards have distinct size/placement provisions.

General flashing and freestanding prohibitions coexist with service-station freestanding allowance in 1185.02(c) and institutional placement in 1185.04. Exception hierarchy unresolved; no blanket freestanding ban or permission.
Variance requests are directed to Zoning Board of Appeals; no granted variance or current filing route inferred.
